parlays.name: Parlay of the Day
parlays.blurb: Three legs, three different games, straight off the top of HOMER's hit board. Nothing here is taken for the price — it is the shortest ticket on the board and the one that cashes most often.

parlays.name: The Lock
parlays.blurb: Two of HOMER's most likely hits, plus one bat the book has underpriced. A longer number than the Parlay of the Day for about the same cash rate.

parlays.name: The Edge
parlays.blurb: Flips the mix: one anchor and two legs where HOMER's matchup read beats the season line the book prices off. More price, a little less certainty.

parlays.name: The Stretch
parlays.blurb: A fourth leg for a bigger number — three likely hits and one value bat. The longest price that still clears the cash bar.

parlays.name: Full Value
parlays.blurb: Every leg chosen for what the book is paying rather than for how likely it is. The purest read on whether HOMER beats the price.
